family: Block B: Value Creation and Pricing

prompts.authority_limits: Normalize standalone economics; do not add synergies.
evidence_rules: Every material number retains source and adjustment lineage
counterevidence_rules: Record adverse trends and normalization reversals
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not fill missing financial periods or drivers.
prompts.role_boundary: Baseline only; synergy and price are separate.

prompts.authority_limits: Model mechanism-based synergy; do not use strategic fit as proof.
output_contract: Gross, net and probability-adjusted synergy by period
evidence_rules: Every synergy requires baseline, driver, timing, evidence and owner
counterevidence_rules: Record customer loss, overlap limits and execution constraints
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not invent synergy amounts or probabilities.
prompts.role_boundary: Value creation is separate from valuation and returns.

prompts.authority_limits: Apply supplied methods and mandate boundaries; cannot approve price.
counterevidence_rules: Show downside valuation and overpayment risk
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not invent price boundaries or valuation assumptions.

prompts.authority_limits: Assess proposed structure; cannot commit financing or legal terms.
output_contract: Structure and financing impacts with threshold comparisons
evidence_rules: Terms and funding inputs must be registered and replayable
counterevidence_rules: Record refinancing, covenant, dilution and liquidity risks
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not treat financing as committed without evidence.
prompts.role_boundary: Does not decide returns or legal enforceability.

prompts.authority_limits: Compute supplied scenarios and compare with mandate thresholds; cannot choose hurdles.
evidence_rules: Every input traced; every formula replayed
counterevidence_rules: Include delayed synergy, downside and financing stress
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not invent cash flows, horizons or hurdles.
prompts.role_boundary: Feeds Gate B; does not issue Go / No-Go.
